integrity: Universal claims have a self-contained algebraic proof; direct-stencil checks for 19 parameter triples are confirmatory only. Historical priority remains to be independently reviewed.
limitations: The operator is the nearest-neighbor periodic two-dimensional Laplacian over the field of the same prime characteristic, with both side lengths prime powers. Rank-one terminal behavior is established only for odd primes. No assertion for other masks, moduli, or nonperiodic boundaries.
title: Exact extinction clocks for prime-power toroidal Laplacian cellular automata
